doc.title: Benny Powell interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 16, 1999 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Closing remarks and a residency pitch
summary: Rowe thanks Powell; Powell suggests a residency at Hamilton with Jane Jarvis and Earl May and possible funding.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well, fascinating. I really appreciate your time again. And I wish you the best in your travels, and all your projects, and your work with Jane.
One time, let me put in my bid for us, if possible, why don’t you have a residency with Jane and I and Earl?
That would be a good combination.
In fact if we can talk about it afterwards, maybe I can help you find some money for it.
Yeah. You’re in New York State?
Well we have the National Endowment and the New York State Council on the Arts.
Well there you go, I’d love to.
